patch.summary: ChatGPT cost guide: researched plan structure, free/trial flags, who each tier suits, cost scenarios, and value tradeoffs — no invented prices.

blocks.heading: ChatGPT cost scenarios to pressure-test
blocks.body: Price ChatGPT against how you actually buy seats and unlocks — not against a competitor's homepage headline.

scenarios.title: Lean team / free-or-trial first
scenarios.body: Stay on Free until a gated capability (LLM chat and assistants (Free, Plus, Business (annual), Business (monthly), Pro, Enterprise)) becomes mandatory.

scenarios.title: Growing team with gated workflows
scenarios.body: Map must-have workflows (LLM chat and assistants, reasoning / advanced models, writing and paraphrasing) to plan unlocks before expanding seats.

scenarios.title: Hidden / extra cost watch
scenarios.body: Budget risk: Free tier has usage and model caps that frustrate power users. Also check add-ons, overages, and admin time outside the sticker plan.

steps.label: Pay up when Teams and individuals wanting a mainstream general-purpose LLM assistant requires a paid unlock you will use weekly

items.title: Cost trap 1
items.body: Free tier has usage and model caps that frustrate power users

items.title: Cost trap 2
items.body: Business enforces a 2-seat minimum — solo buyers pay for unused seats

items.title: Cost trap 3
items.body: Pro and Enterprise tiers gate the deepest model/compute access

items.title: Cost trap 4
items.body: Not a specialist voice, presentation, or ad-creative platform

items.title: Cost trap 5
items.body: Team admin and enterprise governance require paid Business+ packaging
